description: Minimal deployment registration for Backend Core API staging. This is not a production deployment descriptor.

entrypoints.purpose: Local browser/API demo for review center, platform entities, Backend Core APIs, grading jobs, and static frontend pages.
Framework-neutral request/response boundary reused by the standard-library HTTP server and the ASGI adapter.
Mount point for future FastAPI, Starlette, Uvicorn, or platform gateway integration.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_BACKEND_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local/staging Bearer token for /api/* except /api/health.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_BACKEND_CORE_DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.purpose: Backend Core repository URL. sqlite:/// is local staging; postgresql:// requires explicit adapter registration and test/staging database only.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_BACKEND_GRADING_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional local SQLite staging path for grading jobs and records.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_BACKEND_CORE_POSTGRESQL_SMOKE
environmentVariables.purpose: Set to 1 only for optional PostgreSQL smoke tests.

environmentVariables.name: LAB_BACKEND_CORE_POSTGRESQL_SMOKE_REVIEWER
environmentVariables.purpose: Reviewer label used by optional PostgreSQL smoke tests.

storage.externalDatabasePolicy: Only registered test/staging adapters may connect to external databases. Production database writes are not enabled by this manifest.

testEnvironmentMount.stopLine: This smoke proves the current ASGI target can be mounted in-process for core APIs. Do not add another ASGI mount shell unless a real test environment reports a concrete incompatibility.

stopLine: Do not add another deployment shell for the same local/ASGI boundary. Next work should record real CI results, mount this ASGI target in a test environment, or fill real platform API fields when the contract is available.
